tools.name: steam_summary
tools.description: Steam player overview in one call. presets: include=[] equals full; for competitive checks pass include ["faceit","bans"]. Responses carry provenance.fresh and sources/partial - branch on them. Overview: Steam summary, Steam ban status (VAC/game/community), SteamID conversions, FACEIT stats and the

tools.name: steam_bans
tools.description: Steam ban status of a player: VACBanned, NumberOfVACBans, NumberOfGameBans, DaysSinceLastBan, CommunityBanned, EconomyBan - fields exactly as Steam reports them. First thing to check when reviewing a cheating report. Unresolvable ids or an unavailable upstream return an error result, never guessed d

tools.name: steam_profile
tools.description: Steam summary only (raw GetPlayerSummaries object + SteamID conversions). Cheapest profile tool; data no older than 48 hours, unknown profiles are fetched live from Steam. Private profiles return the public subset of fields (not an error); unresolvable ids return an error result.

tools.name: steam_convert
tools.description: SteamID converter: turns one identifier into EVERY other form, instantly. Accepts steamid64, STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex (110000...), steam:hex (FiveM), a 32-bit account id or a steamcommunity.com/profiles/ link. Returns steamid64 (dec and hex), SteamID, legacy STEAM_0 form, SteamID3, acc

tools.name: steam_identity
tools.description: Pure identifier resolver: steamid64, SteamID (STEAM_1:0:x), SteamID3 ([U:1:x]), steam hex, vanity name and profile URL. No profile data - fewest tokens. If the id cannot be resolved, returns an error result with a machine-readable message - never a partial guess.

tools.name: steam_friends
tools.description: Known friends of a player from the platform's snapshot of the public Steam friend graph (cache only, no live Steam call; the snapshot can be partial). detail picks token cost: short - steamid64 array, medium - steamid64 + personaname, full - raw Steam objects. Use short unless you need names.

tools.name: steam_faceit
tools.description: FACEIT player object (nickname, country, per-game skill level and ELO) plus known FACEIT bans. Players without a FACEIT account return an error result saying so - absence of FACEIT data is reported explicitly, never silently.

tools.name: steam_batch
tools.description: Up to 100 Steam profiles in one call. When you need several players, ALWAYS use this instead of per-player calls - one batch of 100 costs one request. Accepts any SteamID format as STRINGS - steamid64, STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id or a /profiles/ link. Never

tools.name: steam_compare
tools.description: Two players side by side: identity, account age, visibility, Steam bans, FACEIT and shared friends (compared over the full friend lists). HEAVIEST tool - it builds two summaries plus both friend graphs; for a single player prefer steam_summary.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "steam_faceit" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "steam_batch" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: steam_batch · Private data: steam_profile, steam_identity, steam_friends · Public sink: steam_batch · Destructive: steam_summary, steam_convert, steam_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: steam_batch · Private data: steam_profile, steam_identity, steam_friends · Public sink: steam_batch · Destructive: steam_summary, steam_convert, steam_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
